summary: Raised the prometheus-client minimum to 0.25.0 across all six package variants, enabled CollectorRegistry support for collectors without statically declared names, and added end-to-end assertions for repeated name[] filtering, unknown-name exclusion, and preservation of the unfiltered metrics payload. The defect was reproduced before the change and the fixed path was verified both through the actual ASGI middleware and a real one-GPU SGLang server.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: an actual multiprocess SGLang ASGI metrics app returned both requested families unfiltered but an empty body for the repeated name[] request. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5e3ffbb1e9dd/failing-before.log
Passing-after regression: the same actual middleware returned both requested families and excluded the unrelated family. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5e3ffbb1e9dd/passing-after.log

Compatibility at the newly declared minimum version: full scrape populated, both repeated requested names present, unrelated metric absent. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5e3ffbb1e9dd/passing-prometheus-0.25.log

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5e3ffbb1e9dd/venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files <all eight changed source/test/manifest files>
tests.what_was_measured: TOML validity, Python AST, formatting, lint, spelling, registered-test metadata, and repository policy checks all passed.
The modified registered observability module imported successfully and all 10 tests, including the one-GPU metrics test containing the new assertions, collected.

Real source-checkout ROCm server with --enable-metrics: full and repeated-name filtered scrapes returned 200; both requested families were present; unrelated and unknown families were absent from the filtered response; ordinary, OpenAI, batch, and streaming generation probes also returned 200. Evidence: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5e3ffbb1e9dd/server-metrics-evidence/metrics.json, run-metadata.json, and server.log

remaining_limitations: No native source was changed, so a native rebuild and compiler/ISA validation were not applicable.

The checked-in Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B registered test was collected but not run with that external model. The same HTTP and multiprocess path was executed end-to-end with the qualified deterministic tiny Llama fixture; this does not claim semantic accuracy for any model.
The gRPC HTTP sidecar uses a separate aiohttp exposition implementation and is outside the source issue's make_asgi_app contract; this change does not add name[] filtering to that separate endpoint.
